Grade: PP1

Strand: GOD’S
Topic 1.3: My family CREATION

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers My family CREATION, part of GOD’S in PP1 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: What is the name of members are a gift from God. sing simple songs thanking God for your guardian?

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES
